MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[r:Owns]->(:Team)
WITH o, r, strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS birth_date, strptime('2026/10/14', '%Y/%m/%d') AS today
WITH o, r, date_diff('year', birth_date, today) - CASE WHEN date_part('month', birth_date) > 10 OR (date_part('month', birth_date) = 10 AND date_part('day', birth_date) > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owner_age
WHERE owner_age <= 76 OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai' OR CAST(r.since_year AS INT64) > 2013 OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN r.since_year AS col1, owner_age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[r:Owns]->(:Team)
WITH o, r,
  CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH o, r,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owner_age
WHERE owner_age <= 76 OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai' OR CAST(r.since_year AS INT64) > 2013 OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN r.since_year AS col1, owner_age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
